description:
Delete one environment from a Sentry cron monitor, irreversibly. The monitor and its other environments are kept; an absent environment counts as success.
To find the monitor and exact environment name, use find_monitors or get_monitor_details.

environment.description: Exact environment name to delete. Preserve whitespace and casing.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

projectSlug.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

name: delete_monitor_environment
title: Delete Cron Monitor Environment
